title: Parameters are copies
prompt: A number handed to a helper is a copy. copy_check hands n to an `add_ten` helper that prints its number plus ten, then prints n itself, so copy_check(5) prints 15 and then 5: the original does not change.
hints: add_ten takes a number, adds 10 to its parameter with += and prints it; copy_check calls add_ten(n) and then prints n. Changing the copy inside leaves the caller's variable alone.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
